core.name: Breeze in Bloom
core.text:
Each 0.01 initial Energy Regen above 1.2 gives +0.21% DMG (max 35%) and +0.5 Anomaly Mastery (max 84). Enters battle with 45 Windbloom (once per 180s in Investigation Zones); Purifying Rise and Triple Deathblow give 45 more (max 135).
Her Vortex gives 1 Windbite and summons a Condensed Cyclone (once per 3s). At 2 Windbite, her next Vortex spends them for +{0}% multiplier and a Sweeping Cyclone instead.
A Sweeping Cyclone's first hit on a Contaminated enemy changes it to that attribute (Chromatic Tint). Its hits lower Wind (and the tinted attribute's) Anomaly Buildup RES by 7% for 35s. It lasts 5s longer if an enemy it hit dies (once; one at a time).
When a Cyclone fades it explodes; on a Wind-Anomaly enemy that triggers Abloom: {1}% (Condensed) or {2}% (Sweeping) of Wind Anomaly DMG.

ability.name: Tea Party Etiquette
ability.text: Her Windswept and Vortex DMG +10%. Her Ultimate's heavy hit on a Wind-Anomaly enemy triggers a 680% Abloom. Sweeping Cyclone lowers Anomaly Buildup RES by 7% more, deals 30% more Daze and builds 15% more Anomaly.

mindscapes: Sweeping Cyclone deals 20% more Daze. Her Vortex ignores 20% All-Attribute RES, and squad Windswept DMG ignores 20% Wind RES.
Windswept also gives 1 Windbite (once per 5s). Tinted Sweeping Cyclones build that attribute's Anomaly (not counted for Anomaly DMG). Her Additional Ability's Windswept and Vortex bonus +15% more.
Spending 2 Windbite on Vortex refunds 1 (once per 6s). +20% Wind buildup on Wind-Anomaly enemies. Reapplying Windswept adds +2.5% DMG per second left on the old one (max 40%).
